lessons.title: Meet my family
lessons.en:
Anna: Look, Ben. This is my family photo.
Ben: Who is the man with glasses?
Anna: He's my father. The kind lady is my mother.
Ben: And the little boy?
Anna: That's my brother. Grandpa and Grandma live with us, too.
lessons.cn:
安娜：看，本。这是我的家庭照。
本：戴眼镜的男人是谁？
安娜：他是我父亲，旁边温柔的女士是我母亲。
本：那小男孩呢？
安娜：是我弟弟。爷爷奶奶也和我们住在一起。

lessons.title: A loving family
lessons.en: There are six people in my family. My father is a doctor. My mother is a teacher. I have one brother and one sister. Grandpa and Grandma live with us, too. After dinner, we sit together and talk. We love each other very much. A loving family is the best gift!
lessons.cn: 我家有六口人。爸爸是医生。妈妈是老师。我有一个弟弟和一个妹妹。爷爷奶奶也和我们住在一起。晚饭后我们一起聊天。我们彼此非常相爱。有爱的家庭就是最棒的礼物！
